## S0 — Story Skeleton

Goal:
story before prose.

## S1 — Evidence Draft

Goal:
attach truth to structure.

Every material claim receives an Evidence ID.

Weakest claim:
Expert consultation needed:
Claims removed because evidence was weak:

Status:
PASS / RESEARCH_MORE

## S2 — Visual Draft

Goal:
write for video, not audio over pictures.

For every major paragraph:
- visual beat
- evidence/document/diagram
- asset idea
- transition possibility
- editor feasibility

Key visual:
Visual transformation:
First 30-second visual sequence:

Motion Editor review:
Art Director review:

Status:
PASS / REWORK

## S3 — Voice / Performance Draft

Goal:
make narration sound human and intentional.

Add:
- intent
- emotion
- pace
- pitch
- emphasis
- pauses
- pronunciation
- breath notes

Owner voice-fit check:

Status:
PASS / REWORK
